title.zh: SYSBrain Multi-agent 平台 — MCP 身分驗證

roles.zh: 專案負責人 · 身分驗證架構設計與後端開發

summary.zh: 平台的「用代理」功能會呼叫外部 MCP Server（n8n）執行工具，原本這條路徑沒有任何驗證，知道網址即可呼叫。
summary.en: The platform's agent feature called an external MCP server (n8n) to run tools — and that path had no authentication at all; anyone with the URL could call it.

zh: 設計並導入以 Microsoft Entra ID 為基礎的 OAuth 2.0 驗證，後端以 client credentials 換發 Access Token 並快取於 Redis
在 MCP Server 前架設 OpenResty MCP Gateway，逐請求驗證簽章、aud、azp 與 MCP.Invoke 應用程式角色
以主機白名單限制 Token 傳送範圍，讓驗證與工具執行分離
en: Designed OAuth 2.0 on Microsoft Entra ID: the backend obtains tokens via client credentials and caches them in Redis
Put an OpenResty MCP gateway in front of the server, verifying signature, aud, azp and the MCP.Invoke app role on every request
Restricted token delivery with a host allowlist, separating authentication from tool execution

title.zh: SYSBrain Multi-agent 平台 — Guardrails 內容防護

roles.zh: 專案負責人 · 內容防護模組開發

summary.zh: 身分驗證把關「誰能呼叫」，這個子專案以 NeMo Guardrails 把關「內容能不能通過」，建立輸入、檢索、執行、輸出四層護欄，共用同一套防護模組與規則。
summary.en: Auth decides who may call; this sub-project decides what content may pass — four NeMo Guardrails layers (input, retrieval, execution, output) sharing one rule set.

zh: 攔截 Prompt Injection（要求忽略規則、洩漏內部設定）
攔截高風險與違禁物品請求
自動遮罩姓名、電話、Email、地址、身分證等個資
en: Blocks prompt injection (ignore-the-rules, leak-the-config attempts)
Blocks high-risk and prohibited-item requests
Auto-masks PII: names, phone numbers, email, addresses, national IDs

title.zh: AI Agent 多元代理協作平台（COMPUTEX 2025 展示）

roles.zh: 專案負責人 · 前端與 AI Agent 後端開發

summary.zh: LangGraph Supervisor 以地端 Gemma 3 判斷意圖，把請求路由到腦力激盪、摘要、搜尋、RAG、Excel 報表與專家顧問等 Agent；各 Agent 以 FastAPI 微服務部署並依任務分派雲端或地端模型。系統於 COMPUTEX 2025 展示並獲仁寶頒發感謝狀。
summary.en: A LangGraph supervisor running local Gemma 3 routes requests to brainstorming, summarisation, search, RAG, Excel-report and expert agents, each a FastAPI microservice using cloud or local models. Demoed at COMPUTEX 2025; received a certificate of appreciation from Compal.

zh: 製作 Gradio 前端（中英雙語、管理者與使用者介面）
以 LangGraph 建構 Agent 流程、FastAPI 提供服務，串接 Ollama 地端模型
調整 Supervisor 與各 Agent 的提示詞，提升意圖路由與回答品質
en: Built the Gradio frontend (zh/en, admin and user views)
Built agent flows in LangGraph served via FastAPI, wired to local Ollama models
Tuned supervisor and agent prompts to improve routing and answer quality

title.zh: MI/SOP 產線作業指導書自動生成系統（Phase 2）

roles.zh: 桌面端與後端 API 開發

summary.zh: 把產品 DFM 設計文件自動轉成產線作業指導書：上傳 DFM PDF 後擷取流程圖頁，以 GPT-4o 視覺模型解析成各工站並產出指導書草稿，於 12 宮格畫面調整後套用 Excel 模板批次匯出。
summary.en: Turns DFM design PDFs into production-line work instructions: GPT-4o vision parses flowchart pages into stations and drafts instructions, which are refined in a 12-panel editor and batch-exported through Excel templates.

zh: 參與 C# WinForms 桌面端與 Python FastAPI 後端，串接 PDF 轉圖、流程圖轉工站、組裝說明轉 MI 與中英翻譯 API
實作 SOP 圖片編輯器（裁切、圖層、色塊與文字框）與工站自動配對
Excel 模板自動產生、合併與匯出，並撰寫系統流程圖與部署說明書
en: Worked on the C# WinForms client and Python FastAPI backend: PDF-to-image, flowchart-to-station, MI drafting and translation APIs
Built the SOP image editor (crop, layers, shapes, text boxes) and automatic station matching
Excel template generation, merging and export; wrote the flow diagrams and deployment guide

title.zh: TP-Claw 零信任 AI 代理沙箱平台

roles.zh: 驗證整合與 Demo 系統開發

summary.zh: 以開源 AI Agent 專案 OpenClaw 為核心，整合 TekPass 與 PC.Sec 零信任技術，建立 AI Agent 專用的安全執行架構：MCP/OAuth2 驗證閘道、WSL2 Sandbox、Prompt/Memory 安全治理與 ATR 靜態掃描。
summary.en: A secure runtime for AI agents built on the open-source OpenClaw, integrating TekPass and PC.Sec zero-trust tech: MCP/OAuth2 gateway, WSL2 sandbox, prompt/memory governance and ATR static scanning.

zh: 參與 MCP OAuth 與 TekPass Keep 驗證流程整合
建置 TPClaw Demo 驗證系統：Agent 偵測訊息後於背景建立驗證檔並啟動監控，外部驗證完成後透過 session key 將結果注入 OpenClaw TUI
en: Integrated MCP OAuth with the TekPass Keep verification flow
Built the end-to-end demo: the agent spawns a verification job in the background and, once external verification completes, injects the result into the OpenClaw TUI via session key

title.zh: TAMI 受眾分析平台（已上線，供台灣大哥大員工使用）
title.en: TAMI Audience Analytics (in production at Taiwan Mobile)

summary.zh: 提供使用者查詢客戶受眾比率並產出報表的平台，已上線供台灣大哥大內部員工使用。
summary.en: A platform for querying customer audience ratios and generating reports, in production for Taiwan Mobile staff.

zh: 門號雜湊比對：雜湊資料存入 HDFS，以 PySpark 平行運算後寫入 Elasticsearch
Flask API 依使用者權限組出 Elasticsearch 查詢，產出行動上網行為變化報表
以 Celery 非同步彙整擴大受眾報表、定時監控 SFTP 自動下載，並匯出 .xlsx
en: Hashed phone-number matching: data in HDFS, processed in parallel with PySpark, written to Elasticsearch
Flask API building permission-scoped Elasticsearch queries for mobile-usage trend reports
Celery jobs for audience-expansion reports and scheduled SFTP ingestion, with .xlsx export

summary.zh: 有線電視收視資料的分析平台。
summary.en: An analytics platform for cable-TV viewing data.

zh: MyVideo 收視紀錄：以 PySpark 彙整觀看紀錄存入 PostgreSQL，計算週／月統計後寫入 Elasticsearch
以 Flask 將使用者的二進位資料轉成可下載的報表
密碼 90 天未更換即強制更換，新密碼以 SHA-512 雜湊儲存
en: MyVideo viewing logs aggregated with PySpark into PostgreSQL, weekly/monthly stats pushed to Elasticsearch
Flask service converting binary user data into downloadable reports
Forced rotation of passwords older than 90 days, stored as SHA-512 hashes
